scope: Three fixed source-peaks, initial-identity, single-length cases; no claim of exhaustive unit/length audit.
analytical_reference: If both states are bit-identical and the centered/residual kernel has positive norm, self-CKA is exactly 1 mathematically. Thus all 15 candidates analytically tie; pair-specific answer designs may change the residual kernel but not self-similarity.
numerical_tie_rule: Exact floating-point equality, matching the frozen rank implementation; no epsilon tie rule or source change.
interpretation: All audited initial identity candidate states are identical. Any strict numerical candidate ordering at ulp scale has no preference interpretation; analytical identity ranks are a 15-way tie whenever defined. Exact frozen metric outputs remain unchanged.
